__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRESQL
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: Postgres datasource pointing at the secops_dashboard database

title: Vulnerability Management
description: Site/severity trending, SLA compliance, CISA KEV exposure, worst-devices hit list and MTTR across every vulnerability source in vuln_findings (Falcon Exposure Management endpoints + Hadrian external).

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content: Endpoint (Falcon Exposure Management) and external (Hadrian) vulnerabilities. Current figures are as at the last nightly run; trends come from the daily snapshots. Hover the **i** on any panel for exactly what it counts.
Severity runs red (critical) to orange (high) to amber (medium) to yellow (low); green only ever means good news. A coverage jump raises counts and lowers rates for a few weeks.

panels.title: Open findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(n), 0) AS "Open Findings" FROM dash_vuln_site_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Open vulnerability findings (one per CVE per device, plus Hadrian's external risks). As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: Critical + high open

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE severity IN ('critical','high')), 0) AS "Critical + High" FROM dash_vuln_site_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Open findings rated critical or high. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: SLA breach rate

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE sla_breach) / NULLIF(sum(n),0), 1) AS "SLA Breach Rate" FROM dash_vuln_site_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Share of open findings older than their severity's SLA. Drops sharply whenever coverage expands, because new findings start at age zero -- read it with the breach count. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: Share on CISA KEV

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(n) FILTER (WHERE has_kev) / NULLIF(sum(n),0), 2) AS "Active KEV %" FROM dash_vuln_site_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Share of open findings whose CVE CISA lists as actively exploited. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: Remote + no-auth critical/high

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(n) FILTER (WHERE severity IN ('critical','high') AND is_remote_no_auth), 0) AS "Remote+NoAuth Crit/High" FROM dash_vuln_site_summary WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Open critical/high findings exploitable over the network with no credentials and no user interaction: reachable by an attacker starting from nothing. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: Remote + no-auth critical/high trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(remote_crit) AS "Remote Critical", sum(remote_high) AS "Remote High" FROM daily_site_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.description: The same count per day, from the nightly snapshot.

panels.title: Open findings by severity

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(crit) AS "Critical", sum(high) AS "High", sum(medium) AS "Medium", sum(low) AS "Low" FROM daily_site_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.description: Open findings per day by severity, from the nightly snapshot. Step changes are usually coverage (more devices assessed), not risk.

panels.title: Net change (opened − fixed)

targets.rawSql: SELECT (COALESCE(sum(opened),0) - COALESCE(sum(fixed),0))::int AS "Net Change" FROM daily_vuln_flow_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Findings opened minus fixed in the selected range, by the day each happened (as the exec reports count them; expired records aren't 'opened'). Positive = backlog growing.

panels.title: Opened vs remediated per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(opened) AS "Opened", -sum(fixed) AS "Closed" FROM daily_vuln_flow_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Findings first detected (up) and fixed (down) per day, from the nightly rollup.

options.content: Today's figure minus the figure 7 days ago. Rates are in percentage points (**pts**): 10% -> 12% is +2 pts, not +20%. Any rise is red. Straight after a coverage jump, trust the counts over the rates.

panels.title: Open findings: change over 7 days

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_site_metrics), hist AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_site_metrics, latest WHERE snapshot_date::date <= latest.d::date - 7), now_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) AS v FROM daily_site_metrics, latest WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = latest.d), then_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(total),0) AS v FROM daily_site_metrics, hist WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = hist.d) SELECT (now_v.v - then_v.v) AS delta FROM now_v, then_v

panels.description: Open findings now minus 7 days ago. Any rise is red.

panels.title: Critical + high: change over 7 days

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_site_metrics), hist AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_site_metrics, latest WHERE snapshot_date::date <= latest.d::date - 7), now_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(crit)+sum(high),0) AS v FROM daily_site_metrics, latest WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = latest.d), then_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(crit)+sum(high),0) AS v FROM daily_site_metrics, hist WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = hist.d) SELECT (now_v.v - then_v.v) AS delta FROM now_v, then_v

panels.description: Open critical + high findings now minus 7 days ago.

panels.title: SLA breaches: change over 7 days

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_sla_metrics), hist AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_sla_metrics, latest WHERE snapshot_date::date <= latest.d::date - 7), now_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(sla_breaches),0) AS v FROM daily_sla_metrics, latest WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = latest.d), then_v AS (SELECT coalesce(sum(sla_breaches),0) AS v FROM daily_sla_metrics, hist WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = hist.d) SELECT (now_v.v - then_v.v) AS delta FROM now_v, then_v

panels.description: Findings past SLA now minus 7 days ago: the count behind the rate, which can fall while breaches rise when coverage grows.

panels.title: SLA breach rate: change over 7 days

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_sla_metrics), hist AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_sla_metrics, latest WHERE snapshot_date::date <= latest.d::date - 7), now_v AS (SELECT round(100.0*sum(sla_breaches)/NULLIF(sum(total_vulns),0),1) AS v FROM daily_sla_metrics, latest WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = latest.d), then_v AS (SELECT round(100.0*sum(sla_breaches)/NULLIF(sum(total_vulns),0),1) AS v FROM daily_sla_metrics, hist WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = hist.d) SELECT (now_v.v - then_v.v) AS delta FROM now_v, then_v

panels.description: Breach rate now minus 7 days ago, in percentage points: 10% -> 12% is +2 pts (not +20%).

panels.title: KEV share: change over 7 days

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_kev_metrics), hist AS (SELECT max(snapshot_date) AS d FROM daily_kev_metrics, latest WHERE snapshot_date::date <= latest.d::date - 7), now_v AS (SELECT round(100.0*sum(kev_open_total)/NULLIF(sum(kev_open_total)+sum(non_kev_open_total),0),2) AS v FROM daily_kev_metrics, latest WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = latest.d), then_v AS (SELECT round(100.0*sum(kev_open_total)/NULLIF(sum(kev_open_total)+sum(non_kev_open_total),0),2) AS v FROM daily_kev_metrics, hist WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = hist.d) SELECT (now_v.v - then_v.v) AS delta FROM now_v, then_v

panels.description: Share of open findings on CISA KEV now minus 7 days ago, in percentage points.

options.content: A finding breaches once its age since first detected exceeds its severity's SLA -- the policy is in the four tiles below, so check them rather than assuming.

panels.title: Critical SLA (days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'critical'

panels.description: Days a critical finding may stay open before it breaches (current policy).

panels.title: High SLA (days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'high'

panels.description: Days a high finding may stay open before it breaches.

panels.title: Medium SLA (days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'medium'

panels.description: Days a medium finding may stay open before it breaches.

panels.title: Low SLA (days)

targets.rawSql: SELECT threshold_days AS "SLA (days)" FROM sla_policy WHERE severity = 'low'

panels.description: Days a low finding may stay open before it breaches.

panels.title: SLA breaches by site and risk (latest snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_label AS "Site", risk AS "Risk", total_vulns AS "Total", sla_breaches AS "Breaches", round(100.0 * sla_breaches / NULLIF(total_vulns,0), 1) AS "Breach Rate %" FROM daily_sla_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_sla_metrics) ORDER BY "Breach Rate %" DESC

panels.description: Per site and risk band: open findings, how many are past SLA, and the rate. Worst rate first.

panels.title: SLA breach rate by risk band

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, risk AS metric, round(100.0 * sum(sla_breaches) / NULLIF(sum(total_vulns),0), 1) AS value FROM daily_sla_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date, risk ORDER BY time

panels.description: Breach rate per day for each risk band, from the nightly snapshot.

options.content: **KEV** = CISA has confirmed the CVE is being exploited in the wild right now: the highest-priority signal here. **Past due** = beyond the fix-by date CISA set.

panels.title: Open KEV findings

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(kev_open_total) AS "Open KEV" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)

panels.description: Open findings whose CVE is on CISA's Known Exploited list (latest snapshot).

panels.title: Ransomware-linked

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(kev_ransomware_total) AS "Ransomware-Flagged" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)

panels.description: Open KEV findings CISA notes are used in ransomware campaigns.

panels.title: Past CISA due date

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(kev_past_due_total) AS "Past Due" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_kev_metrics)

panels.description: Open KEV findings past the remediation date CISA set when listing them.

panels.title: Open KEV trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(kev_open_total) AS "Open KEV", sum(kev_ransomware_total) AS "Ransomware-Flagged" FROM daily_kev_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.description: Open KEV and ransomware-linked findings per day.

panels.title: Open KEV findings by CVE (soonest due first)

targets.rawSql: SELECT kev_cve_id AS "CVE", mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_family) FILTER (WHERE product_family IS NOT NULL) AS "Application", round(max(cvss_score)::numeric,1) AS "CVSS", max(kev_due_date) AS "KEV Due", max(kev_ransomware_use) AS "Ransomware Use", count(*) AS "Findings", count(DISTINCT source_asset_id) AS "Assets", count(DISTINCT site_label) AS "Sites", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') AS "Crit", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium') AS "Med", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low') AS "Low", round(max(age_days)::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)" FROM dash_vuln_kev_epss WHERE has_kev AND site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY kev_cve_id ORDER BY "KEV Due" ASC NULLS LAST, "Crit" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: One row per KEV CVE: what it's in, how many findings, devices and sites, and the oldest. CVE links to NVD. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

options.content: **EPSS** (FIRST.org) = the probability a CVE is exploited in the next 30 days, updated daily. Predictive, the complement to KEV: high EPSS but not yet KEV is the 'likely next' list.

panels.title: High EPSS, not yet KEV

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(high_epss_non_kev_total) AS "High-EPSS Not Yet KEV" FROM daily_epss_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_epss_metrics)

panels.description: Open findings with EPSS of 50% or more (likely to be exploited within 30 days) that aren't on KEV yet (latest snapshot).

panels.title: Average / max EPSS

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, avg(avg_epss) AS "Avg EPSS", max(max_epss) AS "Max EPSS" FROM daily_epss_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date ORDER BY time

panels.description: Average and highest EPSS across open findings per day.

panels.title: NVD enrichment coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM dash_nvd_coverage

panels.description: Open CVE-backed findings with a CVSS vector (from the vendor, or looked up from NVD when the vendor gave none). As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

panels.title: Likely next: high EPSS, not yet KEV (by CVE)

targets.rawSql: SELECT epss_cve_id AS "CVE", mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY product_family) FILTER (WHERE product_family IS NOT NULL) AS "Application", round(max(cvss_score)::numeric,1) AS "CVSS", round((epss_score*100)::numeric,1) AS "EPSS %", round((epss_percentile*100)::numeric,1) AS "Percentile", count(*) AS "Findings", count(DISTINCT source_asset_id) AS "Assets", count(DISTINCT site_label) AS "Sites", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical') AS "Crit", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium') AS "Med", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low') AS "Low", count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_remote_no_auth) AS "Remote/No-Auth", round(max(age_days)::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)", ((count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical')*10 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high')*5 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium')*2 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low')*1) + ROUND((count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='critical')*10 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='high')*5 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='medium')*2 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity='low')*1) * epss_score) + (count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_remote_no_auth) * 5))::int AS "Priority" FROM dash_vuln_kev_epss WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND epss_score >= 0.5 AND NOT has_kev GROUP BY epss_cve_id, epss_score, epss_percentile ORDER BY "Priority" DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: One row per CVE with EPSS 50%+ not yet on KEV. Priority = severity-weighted findings, scaled up by EPSS, plus remote/no-auth exposure. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

options.content: Devices ranked by risk score: severity counts plus a KEV bonus plus a remote/no-auth bonus. A ranking tool, not an absolute unit.

panels.title: Worst devices (by risk score)

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname AS "Host", site_label AS "Site", CASE source WHEN 'hadrian' THEN 'External' ELSE 'Endpoint' END AS "Source", asset_type AS "Type", open_critical AS "Crit", open_high AS "High", open_medium AS "Med", open_low AS "Low", open_kev_count AS "KEV", open_remote_no_auth AS "Remote/No-Auth", round(oldest_open_finding_age_days::numeric,1) AS "Oldest (days)", risk_score AS "Risk Score" FROM dash_asset_risk WHERE site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY risk_score DESC LIMIT 25

panels.description: Devices ranked by severity counts plus KEV and remote/no-auth bonuses. A ranking, not a unit. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

options.content: Which single fixes close the most, worst risk across the region -- not the same as the biggest raw counts. Not filtered by Site.

panels.title: Top 10 patches to deploy (all sites)

targets.rawSql: SELECT title AS "Fix", CASE source WHEN 'hadrian' THEN 'External' ELSE 'Endpoint' END AS "Source", affected_sites AS "Sites", product_family AS "Product Family", affected_assets AS "Assets", open_findings AS "Findings", crit AS "Crit", high AS "High", medium AS "Med", low AS "Low", remote_no_auth_count AS "Remote/No-Auth", CASE WHEN has_kev THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "KEV", round((COALESCE(max_epss,0)*100)::numeric,1) AS "Max EPSS %", priority_score AS "Priority" FROM dash_patch_impact ORDER BY priority_score DESC LIMIT 10

panels.description: One row per fix (e.g. one browser update, or one Hadrian risk). Priority = devices affected + severity + remote/no-auth + KEV + EPSS: the single fixes that close the most, worst risk. Not filtered by Site. As at the last nightly run (pre-computed by rollup_daily_metrics.py).

options.content: How long fixes take: days from first detected to fixed, for findings fixed in the period, and the share fixed inside their SLA.

panels.title: Average days to remediate by severity

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, severity AS metric, avg(avg_remediation_days) AS value FROM daily_mttr_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY snapshot_date, severity ORDER BY time

panels.description: Average days from first detected to fixed, for findings fixed each day.

panels.title: Fixed within SLA by severity (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT severity AS "Severity", round(100.0 * sum(sla_compliant_count) / NULLIF(sum(fixed_count),0), 1) AS "SLA Compliance %" FROM daily_mttr_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date::date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY severity ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

panels.description: Share of findings fixed in the range that were fixed within their SLA.

options.content: Open findings by product from the latest snapshot -- where the backlog actually sits.

panels.title: Top products by open findings (latest snapshot)

targets.rawSql: SELECT product AS "Product", vendor AS "Vendor", product_family AS "Family", sum(open_crit) AS "Crit", sum(open_high) AS "High", sum(open_medium) AS "Med", sum(open_low) AS "Low", sum(open_total) AS "Total" FROM daily_product_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date = (SELECT max(snapshot_date) FROM daily_product_metrics) GROUP BY product, vendor, product_family ORDER BY "Total" DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Open findings per product, by severity.
